current_memory_identity_authority.predecessor_usage: audit-only identity transition comparison; never current Memory identity, presentation, acquisition labels, rank/effect/skill behavior

contracts.acquisition: Main-story Normal/Hard routes are grouped only when m_main_stage proves they are paired; event, co-op, raid and special stages remain exact independent localized records
contracts.character_equipment_colour_bonus: Matching-colour character slots multiply all seven Memory stats by 6/5 and floor each stat independently. The rule is data-driven from the verified runtime-rules evidence file; no per-Memory values are hardcoded. Rainbow eligibility is confirmed, while its exact multiplier is not independently measured.
contracts.compatibility: reverse backlinks show eligible full and partial matches; zero-match and wrong-colour nodes remain hidden
contracts.current_memory_pick_skills: CURRENT_M_MEMORY_ORB_PICK_SKILL; exact-rank new skills, rank<=current cumulative active skills
contracts.current_memory_rank_effects: CURRENT_M_MEMORY_ORB_RANK_EFFECT; exact-rank new effects, rank<=current cumulative active effects; repeated links preserve multiplicity
contracts.rank_progression: D/C/B/A/S shown on Memory pages; vocation Memory nodes remain S-rank only
contracts.skills: only m_memory_orb_pick_skill relationships are shown; Murdaw Memory grants Rubblerouser Spikes at S rank
